tools.name: calculate_solar_shadow_latitude
tools.description: Estimate approximate latitude band and hemisphere from object height, shadow length, and UTC capture timestamp for visual photo verification.

tools.name: lookup_driving_side_and_road_lines
tools.description: Look up left-hand vs right-hand traffic rules, center line colors (yellow vs white), and bollard styles by country or region.

tools.name: lookup_country_calling_and_domain_clues
tools.description: Identify the country from storefront phone dialing prefixes (+1 to +998) or country-code top-level domain (.de, .jp, .za, .br) visible in street photos.

tools.name: inspect_exif_gps_tag_reference
tools.description: Check which EXIF/XMP/IPTC tags leak exact GPS coordinates, altitude, compass bearing, and device serial numbers before sharing images online.

tools.name: classify_six_dimension_osint_clues
tools.description: Generate a structured 6-dimension visual geolocation inspection checklist (celestial shadows, road infrastructure, utility poles, architecture, flora, scripts) for an unidentified outdoor photo.

tools.name: check_social_platform_exif_stripping
tools.description: Verify whether major platforms (X/Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, Discord, WhatsApp, Email, Google Drive) strip or preserve embedded GPS EXIF data upon upload.

tools.name: convert_dms_decimal_coordinates
tools.description: Convert EXIF Degrees-Minutes-Seconds (DMS) rational GPS tuples into standard WGS84 decimal latitude and longitude coordinates.

tools.name: get_geolocation_case_study_methodology
tools.description: Retrieve step-by-step triangulation methodology from verified LocatePic visual forensics case studies (viaduct skyline geometry, desert road roll-fit, urban botany).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_social_platform_exif_stripping · Public sink: check_social_platform_exif_stripping.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_social_platform_exif_stripping · Public sink: check_social_platform_exif_stripping

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
